Resolves #21079

🌿 A week before the cut, nobody has to read six threads to learn what Engine 14 shipped.

Adds `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v14.0.0.md`, iteration 1 behind its banner. It holds the header block with `Release Type` and `Stability` pending the operator, the TL;DR and *14 in 2 Minutes*, and one chapter per census arc on #21032: #20671, #20682, #20498, #20874, #20667 and #20892. It closes with the sections 13.4.0 closes with. Every number links its primary. The window counts and the outside-contributor list come from live GitHub search at 2026-11-16T01:40Z, not from the corpus. The census promised that corrections posted by Mon Nov 16, 18:00 UTC land in iteration 1, so this PR takes them until then.

Evidence: L1 (a document and its link guard; nothing runs) → L1 required (AC-1 to AC-5). AC-6 is the cross-family review.
